description: Look up a specific order with full line item details (product, variant, SKU, quantity, price, vendor). Use orderName for user-facing IDs like '#1001', or orderId for Shopify numeric IDs. Also supports orderIds (array) to look up multiple orders at once — useful for cross-referencing with Triple Whale attribution data.

orderIds.description: Array of Shopify numeric order IDs for batch lookup (max 50)

name: get_order
